subject.title: fix(agents): replace process.exit(1) with throw in findInitialModel

question: Should the shipped `findInitialModel` SDK helper change invalid explicit CLI selection from process termination to a rejected promise?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but the helper is publicly exported and the repository requires explicit ownership of compatibility-sensitive plugin API behavior.

options.title: Approve thrown-error contract
options.body: Merge the rejection behavior as the intended SDK contract and rely on the focused regression test plus exact-head checks.

options.title: Deprecate CLI parameters first
options.body: Preserve the shipped behavior temporarily while introducing a replacement API and a documented removal path for CLI-specific options.

options.title: Keep CLI handling outside SDK
options.body: Refactor internal CLI resolution entirely out of `findInitialModel` before changing or removing the exported behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve thrown-error contract
recommendation.body: Merge the rejection behavior as the intended SDK contract and rely on the focused regression test plus exact-head checks.
